tool_hash_binding: Every tool_files entry must match RELEASE-MANIFEST.json files[].sha256; C00 verifies the manifest hash, C05 verifies every file before C06. A command with an unverified tool file is disabled.
deny_roots_semantics: deny_roots denies writes and unauthorized reads; an explicit read_roots entry grants read-only access to that path while writes remain denied.

argv: if "%P0_TOOLSRC_MANIFEST_SHA256%"=="" exit /b 43 & whoami /user & whoami /groups & echo COMPUTERNAME=%COMPUTERNAME% & echo USERDOMAIN=%USERDOMAIN% & echo OS=%OS% & echo PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE=%PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE% & if exist D:\P47RUN (echo RUNROOT_EXISTS=1) else (echo RUNROOT_EXISTS=0) & certutil -hashfile D:\P47TOOLS\p47-phase0-v3\RELEASE-MANIFEST.json SHA256 | findstr /i /c:"%P0_TOOLSRC_MANIFEST_SHA256%" >nul || exit /b 44
